newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 falls to s/a 24.837 bln stg week to Feb 19.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 falls to s/a 24.837 bln stg week to Feb 19.

text.p: British M0 money supply fell to a provisional seasonally adjusted 24.837 billion stg in the week to February 19 from 25.080 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said on Monday.
On an unadjusted bases M0 fell to 24.174 billion stg from 24.378 billion the week before.
Notes and coins in circulation dropped to 24.804 billion stg, from 24.830, on a seasonally adjusted basis but rose to an unadjusted 24.141 billion from 24.128 billion the week before.
